scope: Narrow static semantic review of final local-chain patch; no new renderer run or production edits. Actual QA remains separately owned.

relative_transform.composition: Premultiply each Node3D local transform while walking upwards. For a descendant of reference, reference_to_common is identity. Board/world common ancestors cancel without global inverse/global recomposition.
relative_transform.reason: The QA-observed square RT dimension flips came from float32 world-transform roundtrip near an exact aspect-ratio truncation boundary. This patch removes common presentation transforms before computing bounds; it does not clamp/round/tune the original dimensions.
relative_transform.scope_boundary: Verified for current ordinary Node3D actor/source-mesh hierarchy. It is not a general guarantee for new top_level renderers, disconnected trees, or future special transform inheritance.

minion_attachment.source_animation: All original local transforms from projection through the source effect root to each mesh remain included. No source effect root scale or animation is discarded.

hero_attachment.registration: native_combat_effects and native_highlight hero holders use the same screen_to_world(hero_position + shake_offset), same 15-degree basis, same PROJECTION_SCALE=0.78*0.9. Status projection precedes the original hero actor root local transform.
hero_attachment.source_root: Original hero root local scale1.1100000143051147 is canceled by the bridge rather than removed from effect child geometry.

fallback: Only explicit actor_relative_anchor opts into attachment bridge. Other attached instances use normal common-ancestor relative_transform(mesh, actor_root).
update_order: game.gd invokes native_status.sync_from_game before native_highlight.sync_from_game, so projection synchronization precedes mask snapshot.
verification: Only file hashes and read-only source relationships were checked here. Parent reported the corrected actual QA comparison passed; final frozen-candidate QA is separate.
